text:
ajay: Heads-up — noticed a ~45% spike in cloud GPU charges for project 'playground-dev' between 2025-03-18 00:00-06:00 UTC. Not tagged to any cost center, billing window shows a big preemptible spend.

maria: Oof. Can you paste the billing query + top-level numbers so we can route approvals?

ajay: Quick BI extract: burst of ~300 preemptible A100 hours (short ML jobs). Top lines:
project_id: playground-dev | cost: $18,386.22
project_id: ci-infra       | cost: $1,120.50
project_id: analytics-sandbox | cost: $420.11

liam: @ajay is playground-dev owned by Platform or ML Infra? Thought that was still under the sandbox budget.

ajay: Platform owns infra, but a couple of data scientists ran unapproved experiments there. Instances had no cost-center tags.

billing-bot: ALERT: Unusual GPU spend detected — project=playground-dev amount=$18,386 window=6h rule=gt(10k). Ticket created: BILL-1709.

sarah: We need to avoid last-minute ledger gymnastics but we also can't let invoices blow past threshold. What's the immediate ask?

ajay: Two asks: (1) One-time emergency reallocation of up to $20k from infra-contingency to sandbox cost center so the invoice isn't disputed. (2) Short-term operational fixes: tag backfill + soft-deny on untagged GPU instance creation + $5k/day budget alert.

maria: I can approve an emergency cover now, but need VP/CFO FYI for retro adjustments. @cecil — can you pre-approve a retro carve-out if we move $20k?

cecil: I approve the emergency $20k cover conditionally: deliver a post-mortem within 48h and attach owner assignment. Also include where Finance will backfill the offset from.

liam: I'll own the post-mortem and assign an owner. Ajay — can you run the tag-backfill script and add a tiny runbook for enforced labels?

ajay: Running backfill now. Will push a soft terraform deny for creating GPU VMs without cost-center tag to staging (soft deny + notify).

maria: Approval recorded in internal ledger REF: AR-2026-03-18. Add this ref to BILL-1709 and include proposed offsets.

ajay: Added ledger ref and note to BILL-1709. Also pushed a temporary budget alert: budget.gpu.playground-dev -> $5,000/day email to #finance-alerts and project owner.

billing-bot: NOTE: Cost assignment updated: playground-dev tagged -> cost_center=platform_playground; invoice allocation pending until retro approval.

sarah: Action items: (1) Ajay — tag backfill + soft deny rollout (2) Liam — post-mortem + owner assignment (3) Maria — finalize ledger entry + follow up with Cecil for retro carve-out approval.

cecil: Keep #finance updated. If post-mortem indicates negligence, we'll consider cost recovery per policy. :eyes: 

ajay: Post-mortem ETA EOD tomorrow. Reallocation executed so invoice should be reassigned before the billing run. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

maria: Closing this thread for now. Reopen if anything else emerges.
